verses.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh. Because of my mighty hand, he will let them go. Because of my mighty hand, he will drive them out of his land."
God also said to Moses, "I am the LORD.
I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as God Almighty. But I did not make myself known to them by my name, the LORD.
I also made my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, where they lived as foreigners.
And I have heard the groaning of the people of Israel, whom the Egyptians are keeping as slaves, and I have remembered my covenant.

So tell the people of Israel: 'I am the LORD. I will bring you out from under the heavy work of the Egyptians. I will set you free from being their slaves. I will save you with my mighty arm and with great acts of judgment.
I will take you as my own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the heavy work of the Egyptians.
And I will bring you to the land I promised to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob. I will give it to you as your own. I am the LORD.'"
Moses told this to the people of Israel, but they did not listen to him, because their spirits were crushed and their slavery was cruel.
Then the LORD said to Moses,
"Go and tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the people of Israel leave his country."
But Moses said to the LORD, "The people of Israel will not listen to me. So why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I speak so poorly?"
But the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron about the people of Israel and Pharaoh king of Egypt. He commanded them to bring the people of Israel out of Egypt.
These were the heads of their families. The sons of Reuben, the firstborn son of Israel, were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. These were the families of Reuben.
The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the families of Simeon.
These are the names of the sons of Levi, in the order of their birth: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Levi lived one hundred and thirty-seven years.
The sons of Gershon, by their families, were Libni and Shimei.
The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. Kohath lived one hundred and thirty-three years.
The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the families of the Levites, in the order of their birth.
Amram married Jochebed, his father's sister, and she had Aaron and Moses. Amram lived one hundred and thirty-seven years.
The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
Aaron married Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she had Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These were the families of the Korahites.
Eleazar son of Aaron married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she had Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families, by their families.
It was this same Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, "Bring the people of Israel out of Egypt, group by group, like an army."
They were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt about bringing the people of Israel out of Egypt. It was this same Moses and Aaron.
Now when the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt,
he said to him, "I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I tell you."
But Moses said to the LORD, "I speak so poorly. Why would Pharaoh listen to me?"
